pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-angular polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients; spatial areas vary from small circular nodes to large, elongated complex polygons.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways forming a dense topological grid of 3-way and 4-way junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively narrow and consistent across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder line visible against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Multiple localized patches of raised, greyish-white textural disruption and crusted scabbing present on the upper-mid lateral flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Nodular skin lesions and textural thickening visible on the flank, consistent with localized skin trauma or parasitic response.
